description_sq:

Fasadë të ventiluar për eficiencë energjetike
Sistem modern ngrohje–ftohje
Termo dhe izolim akustik cilësor
Instalime hidraulike REHAU
Ambient ekologjik dhe të qetë banimi
📞 Për më shumë informacion ose vizitë në pronë, na kontaktoni!
description_en: In the modern Square 21 complex, a 3+1+2 apartment with an area of ​​140 m², located on the 9th floor and under construction, is for sale. It is organized in living room with kitchen, 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms. The complex offers: Ventilated facade for energy efficiency Modern heating-cooling system Thermal and quality acoustic insulation REHAU plumbing installations Ecological and quiet living environment 📞 For more information or a visit to the property, contact us!
